title: 58. Suggest / Prevent / Make / Let / Allow / Help

pages.contentHTML:
Suggest dùng để đưa ra gợi ý. Có thể dùng danh từ, V-ing hoặc mệnh đề theo sau.

Suggest + V-ing: She suggested taking a taxi. Cô ấy gợi ý đi taxi.

Suggest that + S + (should) + V: She suggested that we (should) take a taxi. Chủ ngữ trong mệnh đề là we; sau should là nguyên mẫu. Dạng that we take là giả định thức và thường gặp trong văn trang trọng.

Cũng có thể dùng mệnh đề với động từ chia thì tùy ngữ cảnh: She suggested that we could leave early.

Không dùng suggest someone to do. Để nêu người nhận gợi ý, dùng suggest to someone that … hoặc đổi sang mệnh đề.

Prevent + người/vật + from + V-ing: The rain prevented us from playing. Mưa ngăn chúng tôi chơi.

Stop + người/vật + from + V-ing: A fence stopped the dog from escaping. Hàng rào ngăn chó chạy ra ngoài. Với stop, from đôi khi được lược, đặc biệt trong Anh-Mỹ; học dạng đầy đủ giúp rõ cấu trúc.

Đừng nhầm stop doing (ngừng hành động) với stop to do (dừng lại để làm việc khác): She stopped talking = cô ấy ngừng nói; She stopped to talk = cô ấy dừng lại để nói chuyện.

Make / let + tân ngữ + V nguyên mẫu: They made him apologise. Họ buộc anh ấy xin lỗi. They let him leave. Họ cho anh ấy rời đi.

Allow + tân ngữ + to V: They allowed him to leave. Nếu không nêu tân ngữ, có thể dùng allow + V-ing: They allow smoking outside.

Help + tân ngữ + (to) V: She helped me (to) carry the bags. Cả hai dạng đều đúng.

Ở thể bị động, make dùng to V: He was made to apologise. Không bỏ to trong cấu trúc bị động này.

exercises.questionHTML: She suggested {{taking::Suggest + V-ing: suggested taking a taxi.}} (take) a taxi.
The rain prevented us {{from::Prevent + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.}} [khỏi] playing.
My parents let me {{stay::Let + tân ngữ + động từ nguyên mẫu không to.}} (stay) home.
The teacher made him {{apologise | apologize::Make + tân ngữ + nguyên mẫu không to; cả hai cách viết đều đúng.}} (apologise) to the class.
They allowed us {{to enter::Allow + tân ngữ + to V.}} (enter) the room.
She helped me {{carry | to carry::Help + tân ngữ + V hoặc to V đều đúng.}} (carry) the bags.
He suggested that we {{leave | should leave::Suggest that + S + nguyên mẫu giả định hoặc should + nguyên mẫu.}} (leave) early.
The fence stopped the dog from {{escaping::Sau giới từ from dùng V-ing.}} (escape).
They allow {{parking::Khi không nêu tân ngữ, allow có thể theo sau bởi V-ing.}} (park) outside.
She was made {{to wait::Ở thể bị động, be made to + V.}} (wait) outside.
She suggested ___ by bus. (( to go | **going** | go :: Suggest theo sau trực tiếp bằng V-ing. ))
The guard prevented him ___ entering. (( to | **from** | for :: Prevent + tân ngữ + from + V-ing. ))
They let the children ___ outside. (( to play | **play** | playing :: Let + tân ngữ + nguyên mẫu không to. ))
The teacher allowed her ___ early. (( leave | **to leave** | leaving :: Allow + tân ngữ + to V. ))
Which sentence is correct? (( She suggested me to call. | **She suggested calling.** | She suggested to call. :: Suggest đi trực tiếp với V-ing; không dùng suggest someone to V. ))
He stopped ___ some water before continuing. (( drinking | **to drink** | drink :: Stopped to drink nghĩa là dừng việc đang làm để uống nước. ))
~~ She | suggested | taking | a | taxi. ~~
~~ The | rain | prevented | us | from | playing. ~~
~~ They | allowed | her | to | leave | early. ~~
~~ She | helped | me | carry | the | bags. ~~
The consultant suggested {{reviewing::Suggest + V-ing khi gợi ý một hành động.}} (review) the evidence before publication.
The chair suggested that the committee {{reconsider | should reconsider::Suggest that + S + nguyên mẫu giả định hoặc should + nguyên mẫu.}} (reconsider) the proposal.
The security policy prevents staff from {{sharing::Prevent + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.}} (share) confidential records.
The supervisor allowed the analysts {{to inspect::Allow + tân ngữ + to V.}} (inspect) the original documents.
The court made the company {{disclose::Make + tân ngữ + nguyên mẫu không to.}} (disclose) the figures.
The contractor was made {{to revise::Be made to + nguyên mẫu ở thể bị động.}} (revise) the design.
The grant helped the researchers {{complete | to complete::Help + tân ngữ + V hoặc to V đều có thể dùng.}} (complete) the analysis.
The regulator stopped the firm from {{selling::Sau from dùng V-ing.}} (sell) the product pending review.
The panel suggested ___ an independent audit. (( to commission | **commissioning** | commission :: Sau suggest trực tiếp dùng V-ing. ))
The policy prevents employees ___ personal data. (( to share | **from sharing** | share :: Prevent + tân ngữ + from + V-ing. ))
The board allowed the director ___ the contract. (( sign | **to sign** | signing :: Allow + tân ngữ + to V. ))
The defendant was made ___ the costs. (( pay | **to pay** | paying :: Be made ở bị động theo sau bằng to V. ))
The committee suggested that the report ___. (( is revised immediately | **be revised immediately** | to revise immediately :: Suggest that + chủ ngữ + nguyên mẫu giả định; be revised là bị động. ))
Which means “cô ấy ngừng đọc”? (( She stopped to read. | **She stopped reading.** | She stopped for read. :: Stop V-ing chỉ dừng hành động; stop to V chỉ dừng để làm việc khác. ))
~~ The | policy | prevents | staff | from | sharing | confidential | records. ~~
~~ The | board | allowed | the | director | to | sign | the | contract. ~~
~~ The | contractor | was | made | to | revise | the | design. ~~

A committee reviewed a proposal. One member suggested {{checking::Suggest + V-ing khi nêu một hành động.}} (check) the estimates. A new policy prevents staff from {{disclosing::Prevent + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.}} (disclose) private information. The chair allowed the analysts {{to inspect::Allow + tân ngữ + to V.}} (inspect) the records.

A firm improved its safety procedures. Inspectors made the contractor {{replace::Make + tân ngữ + nguyên mẫu.}} (replace) faulty equipment. They suggested {{adding::Suggest + V-ing.}} (add) a second warning sign. The repairs stopped the machine from {{leaking::Stop + tân ngữ + from + V-ing.}} (leak).

A museum updated its visitor guidance. Staff helped guests {{find | to find::Help + tân ngữ + nguyên mẫu có hoặc không có to.}} (find) accessible routes. The museum allowed visitors {{to enter::Allow + tân ngữ + to V.}} (enter) through a side door. The staff suggested {{using::Suggest + V-ing.}} (use) the lift when necessary.
